sources.title: การจัดการน้ำและน้ำเสีย / Water & Waste Water Managements
sources.locator: Sections Resource, Wastewater treatment, and monitoring / accessed 2026-11-08
reported_claims: The corporate page describes a central wastewater treatment system with Activated Sludge and Modified Covered Lagoon (MCL).
It says the group monitors process wastewater, surface water, and groundwater using standard methods and accredited laboratories under legal requirements and EIA reports.
A separate paragraph says the biological system receives wastewater from sugar factories and biomass power plants.

sources.title: ไฟฟ้า / Biogas Energy
reported_claims: The company says biogas containing methane is produced from spent wash from ethanol production and used to generate electricity for sale to PEA.
It states that 1 tonne of methane is equivalent to 28 tonnes of carbon dioxide avoided.

compatibility_decision.usable_as: Qualitative lead for treatment train, monitoring categories, and potential co-treatment boundary
not_usable_as: methane capture efficiency or leakage rate
numeric CO2e factor for the project
proof that the corporate wastewater-treatment train applies to the ethanol plant alone
compatibility_decision.possible_co_treatment_issue: The page describes a corporate central treatment system and mentions sugar-mill and biomass-power wastewater. Confirm whether ethanol spent wash shares this train and how emissions/energy are allocated before using a site-specific ethanol inventory.

data_request_for_a_matched_lci_period: Actual ethanol output in litres for the same dated operating period
Spent-wash volume, COD/BOD mass load, sample points, and treatment stages for that period
Biogas volume with CH4 fraction and declared dry/wet, temperature, and pressure basis
CH4 sent to engines, flare, vent, dissolved pathway, and measured/estimated slip or leakage by the same period
Electricity generated, parasitic use, exports, and any steam input/output for that period
Wastewater and energy allocation records if the central system receives streams from other plants
